visual_enhancers.blur: Use 'expo-blur' for glassmorphism on navigation bars and modals (intensity: 20-50, tint: 'dark').
visual_enhancers.grain: Optional: Overlay a transparent noise PNG (opacity 0.05) for texture.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop shadows with color matching the element (e.g., Cream shadow for Mic button).

grids.bento: For Reports: Use a 2-column grid. Large item spans 2 cols. Small items span 1 col.
grids.list: For Inventory: Single column, full width items with swipe actions.

motion.interactions: Mic Button: Pulse animation using Reanimated (scale 1 -> 1.1 -> 1).
motion.gestures: Swipeable rows for inventory (Green left, Red right).

accessibility.voice_feedback: Provide haptic feedback (expo-haptics) on voice activation and success.

media.images: Use minimalist, high-quality images. Darken images with an overlay if text is on top.
media.icons: Lucide React Native. Stroke width: 1.5. Color: #F5F5DC or #A1A1AA.

3d_libraries.optional: react-three-fiber (only if complex 3D hero is strictly required, otherwise avoid for performance)

image_urls.description: Minimalist healthy food plate dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup navigation with a custom Tab Bar that hosts the floating Mic button in the center.
2. Implement the Voice Interface first - it is the core feature.
3. Use the 'InventoryItem' component structure for the list.
4. Ensure swipe gestures work smoothly using Reanimated Swipeable.
5. Mock the Voice-to-Text if API keys are missing, but build the UI to handle the 'Listening' state.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Design for thumbs: Important actions at the bottom.
Feedback is key: Every voice command must have visual confirmation (ripple, text transcript).
Zero Clutter: If it doesn't help reduce waste, remove it.
Speed: The user should be in and out in 10 seconds. Auto-categorize voice input.
Accessibility: Ensure high contrast text (#F5F5DC on #0A0A0A) passes WCAG AAA.
Dark Mode Only: The app is purely dark mode based on the 'Sustain' identity.
Use StyleSheet.create: Do not use inline styles for performance.
Use data-testid: All interactive elements must have a data-testid for testing.
